description: One routing item. `features` is exactly the closed model-route/v1 feature set. `label.outcomes` is filled only from real task runs at a fixed budget.

item.split: train | calibration | eval, inherited from the project
item.features: model-route/v1 features (task_family, estimated_context_tokens, requires_structured_output, requires_tools, confidentiality, latency_class)

label.status: measured | seed-author-prior. Only `measured` may be used as evidence.
label.best_route: cheapest logical model whose run was ACCEPTED, else the strongest if none was

<logical model id>.accepted: bool: law gates and tests passed at the fixed budget (never a model's own confidence)
<logical model id>.cost_micros: integer total cost of the run including retries
<logical model id>.attempts: integer attempts used inside the budget
<logical model id>.budget: {max_cost_micros, max_attempts} the run was held to

invariants: a label never comes from a router or another model's confidence
law and test acceptance are never relaxed to make a route succeed
items from one project are never split across train, calibration and eval
